Container.Name: Docket
Container.Overview: Docket keeps a household's home records in one place: rooms, fixtures with their manuals and warranties, paint colours, jobs, receipts and tradespeople. Several people per household, joined by invite link. Needs a PostgreSQL database.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port Docket is opened on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Uploaded manuals, receipts and photos (in uploads/). Docket backs these up nightly to the Backups folder.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Where Docket saves its nightly backups (every record and a copy of every uploaded file). Use a different share or disk from Data, and copy it off this server too.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Docket's PostgreSQL database: postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@UNRAID-IP:5432/docket?schema=public (create an empty docket database first).

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: 32 or more random characters (make one with: openssl rand -base64 32). Signs sign-in sessions; changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: Docket address
Config.Description: The address people open Docket on, used for sign-in and invite links, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000 or https://docket.example.com.

Config.Name: Other addresses
Config.Description: Any other addresses Docket is opened on, comma-separated (for example the LAN address when the main one is a domain).

Config.Name: Backups kept
Config.Description: How many nightly database backups to keep (uploaded files are kept until the backup folder is cleared).

Config.Name: Backup hour
Config.Description: The hour (0 to 23, in the time zone below) the nightly backup runs from.
